name: Natural Spell (Magic Skull Games)
body:
Shapeshifters may take the Natural Spell feat.

Prerequisite(s): For the shapeshifter, the feat prerequisites are: Wis 13, Shapechange class feature, ability to cast druid spells.

Benefit(s): For multi-class druid/shapeshifters, this feat allows them to cast spells while in wild shape and while using the shapeshifter’s shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast or Form of the Dragon abilities.
